issue.body: There is a stack overflow when pressing CMD+R in debug. Seems to call the profiling trampoline in a stack overflow.

body:
I found the issue. There is an incorrect unhooking here:

https://github.com/facebook/react-native/blob/1151c096dab17e5d9a6ac05b61aacecd4305f3db/React/Profiler/RCTProfile.m#L353

Instead, it should be

```objc
RCTProfileUnhookInstance([bridge.uiManager viewForReactTag:view]);
```

issue.title: Fix incorrect unhooking for UI manager views in RCTProfileUnhookModules

issue.body:
## Summary

This PR fixes incorrect unhooking for UI manager views in `RCTProfileUnhookModules`. `view` is actually a key, not the view itself; instead, use `viewForReactTag:` to obtain the view itself.

This fixes issue #24952.

## Changelog

[iOS] [Fixed] - Fix incorrect unhooking for UI manager views in `RCTProfileUnhookModules`, causing an infinite `RCTProfileTrampoline ` recursion (#24952)
